content:
@George H. Seelinger and I have been working on getting Latin Squares into Mathlib (PR #36698) and en route to this we needed the basic result that says given an injective map f : α → β such that β has cardinality one more than α, there exists a unique element of β not in the image of f.

We have moved this basic result existsUnique_notMem_image_of_injective_of_card_succ out of the Latin Square file and into it's own PR #37720. We think we have found a good place for it in Mathlib/Data/Fintype/Cardright under card_lt_of_injective_of_notMem which can be thought of as going in the opposite direction.

We are still getting the hang of the naming conventions and placement and so any feedback is greatly appreciated!
